name: doubleTap (approximation)
description: Approximates GestureHelper.doubleTap(element) in utils/gestureHelper.ts, which actually issues two separate element.click() WebDriver calls 100ms apart rather than a single action chain - this file models that as two down/up cycles at the same point so it can be tested as one gesture here. Coordinates default to screen center (50%,50%); move before executing.
